verdict.rationale: Zoho CRM documents a broad REST API surface: record CRUD, bulk read/write up to 25,000 records, COQL and GraphQL-style queries, composite calls, change notifications, metadata reads for modules, fields and layouts, multiple SDKs, and an official MCP server. Nothing in the evidence claims or demonstrates UI parity. Metadata is documented as read-only ('fetch'), and UI-side capabilities such as creating modules, workflows and reports (shown via Zia) are not evidenced as API-writable. Missing for 10: an explicit API-UI parity statement, API write coverage for configuration (modules, layouts, workflows, reports), a published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of coverage.
